item.title: Ask HN: What are independent software contractors doing now?
item.summary: The amount of opportunities I've found doing independent contracting for people in the last year or two has went from easily being able to find one or two leads a week to none at all for several months. It seems with AI people are just not willing to hire devs for their pet projects anymore? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49357853 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
